title: The Judgeship of Jair
description: After Tola, Jair from Gilead arises and judges Israel for twenty-two years. He has thirty sons who ride on thirty donkey colts and control thirty towns in Gilead, known as the villages of Jair. When he dies, he is buried in Kamon. [ref:Judg 10:3-5|Judges 10:3-5]
